title: calibration.set data (client to server), live YOLOX zoom and camera image (debug panel)

detector.description: Swap the object detector (the same exclusive DPU swap as model.set, status.switching while it runs); yolov5 is error bad_command when not installed. A failed load restores the previous detector.

zoom.description: YOLOX centre-crop magnification before the letterbox (1.0 = whole frame).

zoom_center.description: Crop centre [x, y] as fractions of the (mirrored) frame.

gain.description: Manual V4L2 gain of the RGB camera.

exposure.description: exposure_time_absolute: 100 = 1/100 s, 200 = 1/50 s (both flicker-safe at 50 Hz).

saturation.description: V4L2 saturation of the RGB camera.

person_conf.description: Detection threshold of the person class (objectness * class score).

held_conf.description: Threshold of the loosest held-object class (bottle, cup, cell phone, book); the others keep their config/showcase.yaml offset above it.

description: Any non-empty subset of the values (detector, zoom, camera image, detection thresholds). The thresholds reach the active detector on the next frame, with no reload. Process A applies the zoom to the next frame and the camera controls to the open stream, and stores the accepted values in ~/cpsa/config/calibration.json as overrides of config/showcase.yaml. A value out of range or an unknown key is error bad_command and nothing changes.
